candidate.name: Workshop OS 12.3.8 Review Fixes
candidate.purpose: Fixes confirmed in the review of 12.3.6. Sign-in: POST /login checks the browser's Origin like every other mutation (the sign-in page now sends its own), and the sign-in code key route has its own lock-out that counts only a well-formed wrong wsc_ key, so no web page or LAN client can lock the owner out of sign-in. Touchscreen: Local AI's Allow and Cancel answer only a press that went down on the button at least 500 ms after the prompt appeared, and each Local AI request is refused (409) while the other one's prompt is up. A press acts only on the control it went down on, the touch-down outline follows the finger and is cleared on every path that ends a press. Audio: the unused /audio/mic/echo route is removed, the microphone meter removes the ADC's DC offset, and the recording buffer is never freed while the audio task is using it. Tooling: the stale setup-python check is fixed and runs in CI.
